title: Ali, Parks & X; The Fight for Change
description: Following Muhammad Ali's journey throughout the 60's and 70's, we witness the passing of the civil rights movement, the assassination of John F. Kennedy, Malcolm X and Martin Luther King Jr. In this historical documentary, witness Ali's relationships blossom with some of the greatest figureheads of the African American generation. Their work transcends into our modern day media, art and politics.
